These issues are evident directly from the provided code.

Yes. This set an incorrect foundation and directly led to subsequent steps working from invalid data and the wrong distance metric.

After the initial Haversine approach with mock data, later steps attempted to switch to driving distances via Google Maps but failed due to an invalid API key. They then reverted to simulated distances and finalized results based on those simulations. No actual driving-distance verification was ever completed.
